categories.title: Key
categories.info: Keys are revealed after capturing all the ghosts in a room. Each key is paired to a specific door of the mansion.

categories.title: Locked Door
categories.info: Locked doors are doors that are unable to be opened until Luigi acquires their key. Each door can only be opened with a specific key.

categories.title: Mirror
categories.info: Mirrors can be used to warp back to the Foyer, by Searching them with the Game Boy Horror's Camera on the X button.

categories.title: Save Point
categories.info: Save Points are Toads dotted around the first and second floors of the mansion. The game will also save after every Boss and every Boo.

categories.title: Boo
categories.info: Boos, once released from the Boo Vault, will hide in some furniture of a room with the lights on. Will often break free and escape into an adjacent room, and are harder to catch in unlit rooms.

categories.title: Mario's Lost Item
categories.info: Various items of Mario. Luigi must show all five to Madame Clairvoya in the Fortune-teller's Room in order to capture her.

categories.title: Portrait Ghost
categories.info: Portrait Ghosts are either bosses or mini-bosses, which all require problem-solving to reveal their hearts so that Luigi can capture them. Many of these are optional.

categories.title: Elemental Medal
categories.info: Elemental Medals are items that allow Luigi to vacuum elemental spirits and fire that element with the L trigger.

categories.title: Golden Mouse
categories.info: Gold Mice are rare ghosts that can only be found either by chance, or by Searching a hidden piece of cheese with the Game Boy Horror Camera.

categories.title: Speedy Spirit
categories.info: Fast-flying Spirits that can only be found when a room doesn't have its lights on, and can only be attempted once. These locations only apply to the GCN version of the game.

categories.title: Telephone
categories.info: A minor object that Luigi uses in Area 4 to contact Toad and E. Gadd.

categories.title: Treasure
categories.info: Treasure is used to determine the quality of the game's ending. If treasure doesn't drop from an object, get two rooms away, then come back and try again.

locations.title: Mario's Star
locations.description:
After using the [Telescope](#loc=394191), vacuum a falling star and fire it at the moon. This reveals a path to Mario's Star.

This is the only Lost Mario Item in the same location in the GCN and 3DS version of the game.

locations.title: Mario's Hat

locations.title: Neville
locations.description: To defeat Neville, stand away from him and look away, so that he turns visible in the chair. After a book is thrown at you, he'll yawn, revealing his heart and allowing you to capture him.

locations.title: Lydia
locations.description: To reveal Lydia's Heart, pull back the curtain closest to her using the vacuum.

locations.title: Chauncey
locations.description: Vacuum the Rocking Horse to initiate the Chauncey fight.

locations.title: The Floating Whirlwindas
locations.description: To defeat, stand on the rotating platform they're dancing on and wait for them to finish their dance routine, exposing their hearts so you can vacuum them.

locations.title: Madame Clairvoya
locations.description:
Reveal Clairvoya by shining Luigi's torch onto the crystal ball in the middle of the room.

Clairvoya only be captured after finding and reading all five of Mario's Lost Items. With the exception of [Mario's Star](#loc=394192), all of these items will be in different locations between the GameCube and 3DS versions of the game.

locations.title: Shivers
locations.description: After [lighting his candles](#loc=390954), Shivers will flee to this stool, where you can then capture him.

locations.title: Melody Pianissima
locations.description:
Reveal by interacting with all the western instruments so that they're all playing Super Mario Bros.' "Overworld" (including all three drums). Then, approach the piano.

You'll then play some musical trivia. The answer will be either "Super Mario Bros. 3" or "Water". If you get it wrong, you'll have to exit the room and try again.

locations.title: Mr. Luggs
locations.description: To capture, use fire to light the two candles on the table, then capture the ghost waiters before vacuuming up Mr. Luggs' meal. Dodge Luggs' fire attacks until his heart is exposed, letting you capture him!

locations.title: Spooky
locations.description: Shine a light on Spooky's spot outside the doghouse until it starts attacking you. Dodge him until Mr. Bones shows up, then capture Mr. Bones. He'll leave behind a bone that Spooky will go after, revealing his heart and letting you capture him.

locations.title: Bogmire
locations.description:
To reveal Bogmire, interact with the tombstones to reveal and defeat three Mr. Bones.

In the boss fight itself, vacuum one of the Shadow Bogmires and fire it at the real one. This allows you to vacuum Bogmire for a bit and decrease his health.

locations.title: Biff Atlas
locations.description: To expose Biff's heart, press A on the punching bags to whack him with it. Do this two more times to expose the heart and attempt a capture.

locations.title: Nana
locations.description: To expose her heart, knock over her basket of yarn balls with the A button, then fire them at her three times.

locations.title: Miss Petunia
locations.description:
To expose Petunia's heart for capture, grab some ice from the [Tea Room](#loc=391624) bucket and use it to chill her.

After capturing her, make sure to vacuum the bath to collect any Pearls that fell into it.

locations.title: Slim Bankshot
locations.description: To expose Slim's heart, hit him with three of the billiard balls that go flying after he takes a shot.

locations.title: Henry and Orville
locations.description:
To reveal, spin the ceiling helicopters anti-clockwise four times.

To find them during hide and seek, only interact with boxes that shake when you vacuum them.

media.title: The Twin's Room - Henry and Orville

locations.title: Boolossus
locations.description:
To defeat Boolossus, make it touch the horn of one of the unicorn statues, then use the Ice Element from the statues to freeze and capture as many Boos as you can before it reforms.

In addition to being a Portrait Ghost, Boolossus counts for 15 Boos.

locations.title: Uncle Grimmly
locations.description: Only appears during the [blackout](#loc=394235). To expose his heart, stand in front of him to make him attempt to scare you.

locations.title: Clockwork Soldiers
locations.description:
To activate, turn on the clocks in the northwest and northeast corners on the room, and on the table in the western side of the room. To capture, vacuum the plungers of their rifles as they fire.

Do note that your performance with the blue soldier is what determines the frame of their portrait.

locations.title: Sue Pea
locations.description: Spray with water from [the pot in the Sitting Room](#loc=395500) to wake her. Vacuum her dolls up when the battle begins so they don't pester you.

locations.title: Jarvis
locations.description:
Reveal by disrupting the four northern pots, then play his game and freeze him all seven times. Once you've done this, he'll try and fight you, which is where you can capture him.

You can also get some Bills from this Jar after defeating Jarvis.

locations.title: Weston
locations.description: To reveal, light the two campfires near this spot. To expose Weston's heart, use a fire shot (click L whilst pulling the L trigger down) to instantly melt his protective ice crystal.

locations.title: Vincent van Gore
locations.description: Expose his heart by defeating all seven waves of ghosts that come from his paintings.
